race.comment: FIORA BLUE (4) appreciated the step in distance at the second run of the prep, boxing on well for third over 1800m at this track a fortnight ago. Has raced well over this trip in the past. Cherry ripe now and this looks the perfect set-up. CAPULET (6) has led for the judge at her last three runs but failed to finish off. Drops in class today so she might prove tougher to catch. LONGER ROUTE (1) never got involved over 1800m here last weekend when well in the market. Might be worth one more chance over this longer journey. TOWER OF TUSCANY (9) wasn't far away last start. can feature again.
